author: reek
body: Semantic annotations attached to definitions. An annotation is a typed, content-addressed fact that names its target by stable identifier (chapter + definition name), not source position. Annotations are the discussion layer of the Codex repository.

author: reek
body: Targets reference code by stable name. A target is a chapter name plus a definition path within that chapter.

author: reek
body: Content-addressed store of annotations, keyed by hash. A second index maps target keys to lists of annotation hashes for efficient lookup by definition.
